article.title_es: Gotham Health (Centro de Salud de la Mujer): clínica en Corona, Queens
article.title_en: Gotham Health (Women's Health Center): clinic in Corona, Queens
article.summary_es: El Centro de Salud de la Mujer de Gotham Health es una clínica de NYC Health + Hospitals en Corona, Queens. Ofrece el programa NYC Care, atención médica asequible para neoyorquinos que no tienen ni pueden pagar un seguro médico.
article.summary_en: Gotham Health's Women's Health Center is a clinic run by NYC Health + Hospitals in Corona, Queens. It offers the NYC Care program, affordable health care for New Yorkers who don't have and can't afford health insurance.
how_they_help_es: Es una clínica de salud de NYC Health + Hospitals en Corona, Queens.
Ofrece el programa NYC Care para personas sin seguro médico.
NYC Care es atención médica asequible para quienes no pueden pagar un seguro.
Los servicios y costos específicos de la clínica no están detallados; pregunte al llamar.
how_they_help_en: It is a health clinic run by NYC Health + Hospitals in Corona, Queens.
It offers the NYC Care program for people without health insurance.
NYC Care is affordable health care for those who can't afford insurance.
You can enroll by phone at 646-NYC-CARE (646-692-2273).
The clinic's specific services and costs are not listed; ask when you call.
visit_tips_es: Teléfono de la clínica: 718-334-6300. Llame antes para confirmar servicios y horarios.
Para NYC Care, lleve comprobante de identificación, residencia en NYC, ingresos y tamaño del hogar.
Si no puede presentar los documentos, un consejero aún podría ayudarle a inscribirse.
visit_tips_en: Clinic phone: 718-334-6300. Call ahead to confirm services and hours.
For NYC Care, bring proof of identification, NYC residency, household income, and household size.
If you can't provide the required documents, a counselor may still be able to help you enroll.

faq_es.a: Es atención médica asequible en NYC Health + Hospitals para neoyorquinos que no tienen ni pueden pagar un seguro médico.
Llame al 646-NYC-CARE (646-692-2273), visite una ubicación de NYC Health + Hospitals, una organización comunitaria o una oficina de MetroPlusHealth.
Comprobante de identificación, residencia en NYC, ingresos y tamaño del hogar. Si no los tiene, un consejero podría ayudarle de todas formas.

faq_en.a: It is affordable health care at NYC Health + Hospitals for New Yorkers who don't have and can't afford health insurance.

faq_en.q: How do I enroll in NYC Care?
faq_en.a: Call 646-NYC-CARE (646-692-2273), or visit an NYC Health + Hospitals location, a community-based organization, or a MetroPlusHealth office.

faq_en.q: What documents do I need for NYC Care?
faq_en.a: Proof of identification, NYC residency, household income, and household size. If you can't provide them, a counselor may still be able to help.
